prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which NFL players were both league MVP and Super Bowl MVP in the same season?
answer:
As of August 1, 2024, **seven players** had won both the AP NFL Most Valuable Player award and Super Bowl MVP in the same season:

| Season | Player | Team |
|---|---|---|
| 1966 | Bart Starr | Green Bay Packers |
| 1978 | Terry Bradshaw | Pittsburgh Steelers |
| 1989 | Joe Montana | San Francisco 49ers |
| 1993 | Emmitt Smith | Dallas Cowboys |
| 1994 | Steve Young | San Francisco 49ers |
| 1999 | Kurt Warner | St. Louis Rams |
| 2022 | Patrick Mahomes | Kansas City Chiefs |

Bart Starr’s achievement came in the first Super Bowl, while Mahomes was the most recent player to accomplish the feat in the 2022 season.
